headlines.title: US Selloff Deepens as Democrat Sweep Sparks AI Exposure Worries
headlines.summary: This is the tape right now — the whole AI complex is getting taken out to the woodshed as the Street reprices regulatory risk under a Democratic Congress. Chips, data center plays, neoclouds — nothing with an AI label is safe, and Goldman's traders say the phones haven't stopped ringing. When the VIX moves 11 points intraday and the S&P posts its worst day since April 2025, that's not noise, that's a regime change in sentiment.

headlines.title: Bank of England raises rates for first time since 2023, warns more likely
headlines.summary: The Old Lady of Threadneedle Street just hiked for the first time in three years and telegraphed more pain ahead — that's a global rates story, not just a UK one. Gilt yields are jumping, sterling is moving, and it puts fresh pressure on every central bank narrative that was leaning toward easing; the long bond crowd on both sides of the Atlantic needs to reprice. Add this to a day when Treasuries are already soaring on a flight-to-quality bid and you've got a real cross-asset mess.

headlines.title: Tankers hit in Hormuz as Iran keeps up pressure after US vote
headlines.summary: Tankers getting hit in the Strait of Hormuz is the kind of headline that wakes up the oil desk at 3am — roughly 20% of global seaborne crude flows through that chokepoint, and Iran is clearly not done making noise post-election. Oil already cratered nearly 9% on the Democratic sweep Wednesday, so any re-escalation here is a violent two-way trade for energy names and shipping stocks. Keep one eye on USO and the tanker names; this one can move fast.
